overview_description.description: Ahoy is an AI infrastructure company that builds systems for real-world operations, enabling automation, logistics optimization, and intelligent decision-making. It connects digital intelligence with physical environments such as transportation, supply chains, and urban systems. By using AI and data-driven tools, Ahoy helps enterprises improve efficiency, coordination, and operational performance at scale.
